text_block_list.text:
On this day, I was walking around town with Fenomeno
on a bit of a patrol. That said, the town was completely peaceful, and...

text_block_list.name: Girls
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaー!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: A child screaming?! —I'm on my way!

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
H-Hurry, hurry!
If we get caught, we'll be...!

text_block_list.name: Girl B
text_block_list.text:
Eh, wait, a-a huge person...
Over here too, Lord Furlong—?!
choice_data_list: C-Calm down! I came to help!
C-Calm down! I'm here to help!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: A-And so... may I ask who exactly this Lord Furlong is...?

text_block_list.name: Girl A
text_block_list.text:
Lord Furlong is... a tall, mysterious figure wearing red and white stripes...
Everyone's been whispering rumors about him lately...

text_block_list.name: Girl B
text_block_list.text:
W-We didn't believe it at all either, but...
just now, w-we saw it...
I-It was actually, really there...
choice_data_list: We can't just overlook this, Fenomeno.
We can't just overlook this, Fenomeno.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: I-I-I am quite all right, sir...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: W-Well, let's start with the basics of investigation: q-questioning people!!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, that's an urban legend going around lately.
My kid was talking about it too.
Saying, 'If she catches you, she'll turn you into a furlong pole~'.

text_block_list.name: Occult-Loving Young Man
text_block_list.text:
They say if there's an unnatural furlong pole in town,
it's actually the remains of a victim.
You'd better watch out too, hear?

text_block_list.name: Mysterious Old Man
text_block_list.text: Creatures like that rarely ever come to town... This might be an omen of some great calamity to come...

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
W-W-W-We've gathered, g-gathered quite a bit
of intel, sir...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: N-No way!! An aspiring ally of justice could n-never be scared of g-ghosts――

text_block_list.name: Girl C
text_block_list.text: Kyaaaaー!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Kyaaah!?!?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Gah!? No... that was a child's scream!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: ...No way!!

text_block_list.name: Girl C
text_block_list.text: Someooonneee!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Is it truly all right, or—

Deep in the alley, a mysterious figure in red-and-white stripes
swayed and squirmed...
The moment it noticed me—

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Ah, a-aaah...

text_block_list.name: Girl C
text_block_list.text: W-Waaaaah! I'm so scared~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Ngh, ......grrgh!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
A-A child... A child is crying...
How can I... how can I just stand here being scared and cowering?!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
U-U-Uwooooh!
I can-cannot let the children be put through
any more sc-scary things, sir!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
WAAAAAAIIIIITTTT!
I WON'T LET YOU GET AWAAAAYYY!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Target secureee!!!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
To think it was just a human in disguise...
Honestly, what a needless panic to cause!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
No, I merely did my duty, sir!
Now, I shall immediately go inform the children that the threat of Lord Furlong has passed!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(Fufu, I can vividly picture the children's smiling faces...
Yes, at last, I have accomplished it!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
(Now, this wonderful piece of news!
Must be delivered clearly and directly
to them!)

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text: Heeeeeeeey! E-Eveeeeryooonne!

text_block_list.name: Children
text_block_list.text: Gyaaaaa! A-A monster, it's a monsteer!

The children scattered like baby spiders,
leaving only Fenomeno behind—
choice_data_list: Suddenly calling out to them out of the blue might scare them, though.
...Well, even if you don't say anything, the truth will spread soon enough.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I was just so happy that we solved the case, that I couldn't help it...
I deeply regret my actions!!
Fenomeno's face grew hot with embarrassment at her own inadequacy.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed, sir.
Children, you may rest at ease now.

However, in the days that followed, rumors of a new urban legend—
"The Screaming Nag"—began to circulate in place of Phantom Furlong.
